syllabus_version.title: CBSE Curriculum for the Academic Year 2026-27

book.title: Business Studies-II
book.edition: NCERT (reprint year not stated in the prelims)

topics.title: Business finance, financial management and its objective
topics.ncert_sections: Meaning of Business Finance; Financial Management; Importance; Objectives

concepts.learning_objective: Explain the meaning of business finance and why it is needed at every stage of a business.
Describe financial management and how its decisions shape the financial statements of a business.
Explain wealth maximisation as the primary objective of financial management.

topics.title: Investment decision (capital budgeting)
topics.ncert_sections: Investment Decision; Factors affecting Capital Budgeting Decision

concepts.learning_objective: Distinguish long-term (capital budgeting) and short-term (working capital) investment decisions.
Explain the factors affecting capital budgeting decisions: cash flows, rate of return and investment criteria.

topics.title: Financing decision
topics.ncert_sections: Financing Decision; Factors Affecting Financing Decisions

concepts.learning_objective: Explain the financing decision, financial risk and floatation cost of different sources of funds.
Apply the factors affecting financing decisions to business situations.

topics.title: Dividend decision
topics.ncert_sections: Dividend Decision; Factors Affecting Dividend Decision

concepts.learning_objective: Explain the dividend decision as the split of profit between dividend and retained earnings.
Apply the factors affecting dividend decisions to business situations.

topics.title: Financial planning
topics.ncert_sections: Financial Planning; Importance

concepts.learning_objective: State the meaning, process and twin objectives of financial planning.
Explain the importance of financial planning and how it differs from financial management.

topics.title: Capital structure and trading on equity
topics.ncert_sections: Capital Structure; EBIT-EPS analysis; Trading on Equity

concepts.learning_objective: Explain capital structure, debt-equity ratio, financial leverage and the risk of debt.
Use EBIT-EPS analysis to judge when trading on equity raises EPS.

topics.title: Factors affecting the choice of capital structure
topics.ncert_sections: Factors affecting the Choice of Capital Structure

concepts.learning_objective: Calculate and interpret the interest coverage ratio and debt service coverage ratio.
Apply factors such as tax rate, cost of equity, risk, control and market conditions to capital structure choices.

topics.title: Fixed and working capital
topics.ncert_sections: Fixed and Working Capital: Meaning; Management of Fixed Capital; Working Capital; Factors

concepts.learning_objective: Explain the management of fixed capital and the factors affecting its requirement.
Analyse the factors affecting the working capital requirement of a business.
Define current assets, current liabilities and net working capital.

topics.title: Meaning and features of marketing
topics.ncert_sections: Marketing; Understanding Market; Features of Marketing; Marketing versus Selling

concepts.learning_objective: Explain marketing as a social process and the modern meaning of market, including its relevance beyond business firms.
Distinguish needs from wants and state the conditions necessary for an exchange to take place.
Distinguish marketing, a wide set of activities before and after production, from selling.

topics.title: Marketing management and its philosophies
topics.ncert_sections: Marketing Management; Marketing Management Philosophies

concepts.learning_objective: Explain marketing management as choosing target markets and getting, keeping and growing customers, including managing demand.
Describe the focus and assumptions of the production and product concepts.
Compare the selling, marketing and societal marketing concepts on their starting point, focus, means and ends.

topics.title: Functions of marketing
topics.ncert_sections: Functions of Marketing

concepts.learning_objective: Identify gathering and analysing market information and marketing planning as marketing functions.
Distinguish standardisation from grading and explain when grading is needed.
Explain functions such as customer support, storage and transportation and the gaps they remove.

topics.title: Marketing mix and classification of products
topics.ncert_sections: Marketing Mix; Products; Classification of Products

concepts.learning_objective: Identify the four Ps of the marketing mix and the view of a product as a bundle of utilities.
Classify consumer products by shopping effort and by durability, with their marketing implications.
Classify industrial products into materials and parts, capital items, and supplies and business services.

topics.title: Branding, packaging and labelling
topics.ncert_sections: Branding; Packaging; Labelling

concepts.learning_objective: Distinguish brand, brand name, brand mark and trade mark.
Identify the levels of packaging and the functions packaging performs.
Explain the functions performed by a label on a product package.

topics.title: Pricing and factors affecting price determination
topics.ncert_sections: Pricing; Factors affecting Price Determination

concepts.learning_objective: Distinguish fixed, variable and semi-variable costs and compute total cost.
Explain how cost, utility and demand, competition, government regulation and marketing methods affect price.
Relate pricing objectives such as market share, survival and quality leadership to the price set.

topics.title: Physical distribution
topics.ncert_sections: Physical Distribution; Components of Physical Distribution

concepts.learning_objective: Identify order processing, transportation, warehousing and inventory control as components of physical distribution.
Analyse the cost and service trade-offs in warehousing location and inventory levels.

topics.title: Promotion mix
topics.ncert_sections: Promotion; Promotion Mix; Advertising; Personal Selling; Sales Promotion; Public Relations

concepts.learning_objective: Explain the features and merits of advertising and evaluate the objections raised against it.
Explain the features of personal selling and when it is preferred over advertising.
Identify sales promotion activities and the role of publicity and public relations.

topics.title: Introduction and need for consumer protection
topics.ncert_sections: Introduction; Importance of Consumer Protection; Need for Consumer Protection

concepts.learning_objective: Explain the shift from caveat emptor to caveat venditor and why consumer protection matters to both consumers and business.
Identify unfair practices such as adulteration, hoarding, overcharging and faulty weights from which consumers need protection.

topics.title: Importance from the consumers' and business's point of view
topics.ncert_sections: From Consumers' point of view; From the point of view of Business

concepts.learning_objective: Explain consumer ignorance, unorganised consumers and widespread exploitation as reasons for consumer protection.
Explain why consumer protection is in the interest of business: long-term interest, society's resources, social responsibility, moral justification and government intervention.

topics.title: The Consumer Protection Act 2019: who is a consumer and key terms
topics.ncert_sections: The Consumer Protection Act, 2019; Who is a Consumer?; Terms & Definitions

concepts.learning_objective: Decide whether a person is a consumer under the Consumer Protection Act 2019.
Distinguish key terms of the Act such as spurious goods, defect, deficiency, unfair and restrictive trade practice.

topics.title: Consumer rights
topics.ncert_sections: Consumer Rights

concepts.learning_objective: Identify the six consumer rights under the Act and apply them to situations.

topics.title: Consumer responsibilities
topics.ncert_sections: Consumer Responsibilities; Marks indicating quality

concepts.learning_objective: Explain the responsibilities a consumer should observe while buying and using goods and services.
Match quality marks such as ISI, Agmark, FPO and Hallmark to the products they certify.

topics.title: Ways and means of consumer protection
topics.ncert_sections: Ways and Means of Consumer Protection

concepts.learning_objective: Distinguish self-regulation, business associations, consumer awareness, consumer organisations and government as ways of protecting consumers.
State the role of the Central Consumer Protection Authority under the Act.

topics.title: Redressal agencies under the Consumer Protection Act
topics.ncert_sections: Redressal Agencies Under The Consumer Protection Act; Setting up of Consumer Mediation Cell

concepts.learning_objective: Determine the correct commission for a complaint from the value of goods or services paid as consideration.
Explain appeal periods between commissions and the mediation process under the Act.

topics.title: Reliefs available and role of consumer organisations and NGOs
topics.ncert_sections: Relief Available; Role of Consumer Organisations and NGOs

concepts.learning_objective: Identify the reliefs a consumer commission may order and apply them to cases.
Describe the functions of consumer organisations and NGOs in protecting consumers.
